page.trustTitle: This is not tax fraud. It is a right the law already provides.
page.trustDescription: ISAI has calculation bases and criteria that may have been applied incorrectly. Mexican law provides formal mechanisms to request a refund when there is a legal basis.

calculator.title: Estimate how much you could recover
calculator.description: Answer three questions. You will see an indicative range, not an exact figure or promise of results.
calculator.cityLabel: Where did you buy your property?
calculator.propertyLabel: What was the property value when you bought it?
calculator.propertyHelper: Enter a value in Mexican pesos. The calculator starts at $1,000,000 MXN.
calculator.yearLabel: What year did you buy it?
calculator.yearHelper: The year helps review the applicable deadline; it does not by itself determine eligibility.
calculator.timingNote: The final figure depends on your agreement, receipts, authority, and applicable deadlines. This result is a general estimate.
calculator.resultDescription: We show a range to avoid guaranteed expectations. Our team confirms the final amount at no cost.
calculator.investmentBasis: The tier uses the lower end of the recovery range and must be confirmed during the assessment.

investmentTiers.low: Estimated recovery below $185,000 MXN: $12,500 MXN initial investment.
investmentTiers.midLow: Estimated recovery from $185,000 to under $200,000 MXN: $15,000 MXN initial investment.
investmentTiers.midHigh: Estimated recovery from $200,000 to under $250,000 MXN: $20,000 MXN initial investment.
investmentTiers.high: Estimated recovery of $250,000 MXN or more: $25,000 MXN initial investment.
